about: Rank table of the Archmage. model is a Claude Code alias (haiku, sonnet, opus: Claude Code picks the newest model of that family it supports, and the room shows which one) or a full model id such as claude-opus-5-5, which needs a Claude Code new enough to know it. effort is Claude Code's reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Override any field in ~/.config/codewizards/ranks.json (Linux; see docs/arquitectura.md for other systems). Estimates are input + output tokens per task, provisional until the evals measure them.
